subject: Performance surge in Verity Health private deployment — operational deep dive & leadership note
messages:
From: Anne Cho <anne.cho@verityhealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: SysOps Team <sysops@verityhealth.com>
Date: 2028-04-25T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Sudden P95 latency spike on private cluster (started 08:30 PDT)

Priya —

We started seeing a sharp p95 latency increase across our VPC private deployment starting ~08:30 PDT this morning. User-facing errors are low but latency for inference has doubled (p50 unchanged, p95 ~ 4.5s -> 9.8s). Throughput for the background batch job is also queuing and hitting timeouts.

Attached is a short snapshot from our Prometheus/Grafana export and a tarball with the last 3 hours of logs (perf_snapshot_20280425.zip). We have a maintenance window later tonight but this is impacting a small percentage of active traffic and we'd like help now.

Can Redwood confirm if anything changed on the private agent side or if you’re seeing resource contention / kernel regressions that align with our metrics?

—Anne
Anne Cho
Senior SRE, Verity Health
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Anne Cho <anne.cho@verityhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-25T08:55:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden P95 latency spike on private cluster (started 08:30 PDT)

Anne — thanks for the heads up and the snapshot. We saw the alert in our telemetry at ~08:33 as well and have kicked off a triage. I’m looping in Markus (runtime) and Evelyn (customer ops) to lead the investigation; Marissa is looped for situational awareness given the potential exec impact.

Immediate asks from our side:
- Markus/Evelyn, can you review the KV cache heatmaps + kernel logs (I attached the perf snapshot to the ticket SUP-1234) and confirm whether this is a runtime regression or a workload pattern change?
- Anne, can you share whether you rolled any new model weights, quantization, or traffic-shaping earlier today? Any recent config drift?

We’ll send a mitigation plan within 30 minutes.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Account Lead — Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Anne Cho <anne.cho@verityhealth.com>
Date: 2028-04-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden P95 latency spike on private cluster (started 08:30 PDT)

Quick summary of initial findings (10:30 UTC):
- KV cache churn increased sharply at 08:28 PDT for multiple hot shards. Hit rate dropped from ~94% -> 61%.
- We see frequent fallback to uncached path plus a small increase in cross-GPU transfers (~12% higher).
- No infra-level kernel rollout from Redwood in the last 24h. Cluster node metrics show elevated GPU memory allocation variance on nodes serving the hot shard set.
- Candidate root causes: new workload pattern (longer prefix sequences) causing cache eviction; a model variant with a larger KV footprint; or local OS scheduler contention on a subset of nodes.

Immediate mitigation plan (executing now):
1) Apply temporary prefix-level routing to divert 15% of traffic off the hot shard group to a compatible replica (reduces load on affected nodes).
2) Push a roll-forward to an earlier quantization/profile (we have a validated rollback snapshot) for the small cohort of requests that switched to the larger model variant.
3) Evict and warm targeted KV caches on the hot shard nodes to restore hit rates.

I’ve attached the kv_profile_dump_0425.json for details. I’ll post a post-mitigation report in SUP-1234 in 45 minutes.

—Markus
Senior Backend Engineer — Runtime
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Anne Cho <anne.cho@verityhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Michael Grant <michael@mg-ops.com>
Date: 2028-04-25T10:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden P95 latency spike on private cluster (started 08:30 PDT)

Anne —

Thanks for your patience. We implemented the mitigation steps Markus listed at 09:20 PDT and are observing partial recovery: p95 has moved from 9.8s down to ~5.6s and KV hit rate is improving. We are continuing the warming process and will leave the temporary routing in place until p95 stabilizes near baseline.

Planned next steps tonight (0200-0300 PDT maintenance window):
- Execute a controlled rollback of the small model variant to the prior quantization profile for all traffic, with automated canary checks and a 15-minute rollback window if regressions appear. (rollforward_plan_0425.pdf attached)
- Run a targeted node-level OS scheduler audit on the hot nodes and apply tuned cgroup settings if we see contention.

Marissa has also asked me to escalate to leadership for visibility because the metric moved into the executive reporting window this morning. Marissa, do you want a one-pager for the leadership update or should I include a short note along with the post-mortem?

—Priya
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-25T12:40:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Performance surge in Verity Health private deployment — leadership visibility

Team —

Quick leadership note I just sent to VP Product and SVP Eng: the Verity Health private deployment experienced a targeted p95 regression this morning driven by KV cache churn and a small-model-variant footprint change. Markus is executing mitigations; Priya is coordinating customer comms.

I recommend we prepare a one-page slide for the exec standup with: timeline, impact (traffic % affected, p95 delta, financial/SL implications), root-cause hypotheses, actions taken, and next steps including the maintenance rollback. Evelyn — please prepare the customer impact slide and include any ask for credits/contract levers we may need to discuss with Sales.

I’ll follow up if exec asks for additional context.

—Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Anne Cho <anne.cho@verityhealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: SysOps Team <sysops@verityhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-25T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden P95 latency spike on private cluster (started 08:30 PDT)

Priya/Markus —

Thanks — we’re seeing p95 back down to ~3.8s in our dashboards and background batch queue drain is progressing. The maintenance window tonight is fine; we appreciate the targeted rollback and the extra monitoring. Please include the final post-mortem when available and flag any long-term changes (KV sizing guidance, model variant warnings) so we can bake them into our ops runbook.

I’ll close the ticket in our system after the maintenance but will keep SUP-1234 linked to your post-mortem.

—Anne
